VdpBool is_support_queryVideoSurface(xxx enum  y)
 
               ->VideoSurfaceQueryCapabilities(ddd chroma_types[x].id,        &is_supported, &max_width, &max_height);
->VideoSurfaceQueryGetPutBitsYCbCrCapabilities(ddd chroma_types[x].id, ycbcr_types[y].id,

/***************** Output surface ****************/
VdpBool is_support_ycbcr_OutputSurface(xxx enum   y)

                ->OutputSurfaceQueryCapabilities(ddd rgb_types[x].id,         &is_supported, &max_width, &max_height);
->OutputSurfaceQueryGetPutBitsNativeCapabilities(ddd rgb_types[x].id,         &native);   
    ->OutputSurfaceQueryPutBitsYCbCrCapabilities(ddd rgb_types[x].id, ycbcr_types[y].id,      &is_supported);

VdpBool is_support_indexed_OutputSurface(xxx enum   y)
                ->OutputSurfaceQueryCapabilities(ddd rgb_types[x].id,                &is_supported, &max_width, &max_height);
->OutputSurfaceQueryGetPutBitsNativeCapabilities(ddd rgb_types[x].id,                &native);
  ->OutputSurfaceQueryPutBitsIndexedCapabilities(ddd,rgb_types[x].id, indexed_types[y].id,   VDP_COLOR_TABLE_FORMAT_B8G8R8X8, &is_supported);

/***************** Bitmap surface ****************/
VdpBool is_support_queryBitmapSurface(xxx)
->BitmapSurfaceQueryCapabilities(ddd rgb_types[x].id,          &is_supported, &max_width, &max_height);

/******************* Video mixer ****************/

VdpBool is_support_queryVideoMixer_Feature(xxx)
->VideoMixerQueryFeatureSupport(ddd mixer_features[x].id,              &is_supported);

VdpBool is_support_queryVideoMixer_Parameter(xxx)
->VideoMixerQueryParameterSupport(ddd mixer_parameters[x].id,              &is_supported);
->VideoMixerQueryParameterValueRange(ddd mixer_parameters[x].id,        (void *)&minval, (void *)&maxval);

VdpBool is_support_queryVideoMixer_AttributeValueRange(xxx)
->VideoMixerQueryAttributeSupport(ddd mixer_attributes[x].id,               &is_supported);
->VideoMixerQueryAttributeValueRange(ddd mixer_parameters[x].id,          (void *)&minval, (void *)&maxval);

/******************* Decoder ****************/
VdpBool is_support_queryDecoderCaps(xxx)
->DecoderQueryCapabilities(ddd decoder_2profiles[x].id,         &is_supported, &max_level, &max_macroblocks, &max_width, &max_height);
